name: Motoki Tsukasa
source: Protagonist of the story and one of the last two members of the light-music club. Although he’s officially part of the club, he only attends for the company of his girlfriend/senpai, Nami, and takes no real part in its activities. He has a terrible relationship with his parents, and makes no attempts to mend it. Like the rest of the characters, he often gets roped into doing shit with Maiko. Enjoys pondering about stars.
